about: Pieces this repository copied from another of the founder's products (Cross Universal), the sharing map. origin_sha256 is the origin file's SHA-256 at origin_commit; local_sha256 is this file's. A verbatim piece equals its origin; an adapted piece says what changed; a shaped-on piece is written new on the same model, rulings and defaults. 'Do not rebuild what has been built: copy it.' Regenerate with: node tools/commons.mjs

pieces.name: The plain-words reader (D-472)
pieces.note: Run over every public sentence in tests/plainwords-test.mjs.

pieces.name: Rate limits and the code lockout, in Postgres
pieces.note: The tables are in migrations/0001.

pieces.name: The stand-in for Supabase's auth schema and roles
pieces.note: Railway's Postgres has no auth schema; the server applies this first.

pieces.name: The migration freeze tool: an applied migration is never edited
pieces.note: migrations/FROZEN.sha256 is its record; the unit test and the server both refuse an edited file.

pieces.name: railway.json: Dockerfile build, /api/health check
pieces.note: Unchanged.

pieces.name: .dockerignore
pieces.note: Unchanged.

pieces.name: .gitignore
pieces.note: Unchanged.

pieces.name: The Dockerfile: Node 22, lockfile packages only, unprivileged user, port 8080
pieces.note: One comment line names this product. The build is unchanged.

pieces.name: The database connection checks who it talks to (D-389)
pieces.note: One change: the default database name is linked_ministries.

pieces.name: Outbound email, with the truth told either way
pieces.note: The text-message sender is gone, the default From names this site, and a Reply-To can be set.

pieces.name: One pool, three ways in (admin, signed-in person, the public); migrations on boot with a refusal when one was edited
pieces.note: Adds asAnon for the public pages; drops the host stamp and the acting-admin helper; the migration table is lm_migrations.

pieces.name: Security headers and the same-origin lock
pieces.note: The no-index and no-store paths are this site's. The policy is the original's: script-src 'self', no inline script, no nonce to forget.

pieces.name: The boot guard
pieces.note: The health-records guard, the demo mode and the text-message channel are removed; mail is required in production.

pieces.name: A fresh database from the migrations on a local Postgres 16
pieces.note: Default name linked_ministries; refuses the name lexos.

pieces.name: Passwordless sign-in and sessions
pieces.note: Six-digit code by email, hash-stored, ten minutes, five tries, one use, five wrong codes lock an address, thirty-day httpOnly sessions. Anyone may sign in (the first sign-in makes the person); the phone channel is gone; the answer says plainly when no email can be sent.

pieces.name: The signed-in routes, each a thin door on the database
pieces.note: Same pattern (asUser, functions decide, early friendly checks). The routes are this product's: ministries, team, posts, answers, stewards.

pieces.name: The server: health, sign-in, API, pages, boot
pieces.note: Same boot order and health answer (two words). Public pages are built on the server.

pieces.name: What the database's refusals say, in calm words
pieces.note: Same refusal mapping (a code and a hint); the codes are this product's. The founder's one editable line lives here.

pieces.name: Building a page without writing a person's words as markup
pieces.note: Same h() and api() helpers; the forms are this product's.

pieces.name: Sign-in tables, sessions, rate limits
pieces.note: The login_codes, sessions and rl tables and functions; the organisation and roles are left out.

pieces.name: Ministries, people, the last lead, the record of every act, stewards
pieces.note: The last-administrator rule becomes the last-lead rule; the events trigger (ids and field names only, a name on every row) is the original's audit pattern.

pieces.name: Posts and answers, row-level security
pieces.note: Same pattern: RLS decides which rows, functions decide who may change them, the audit trigger names every act, a record that was sent is never changed.

pieces.name: What each database role may reach, column by column
pieces.note: Same least-privilege pattern; the public (anon) role gets named columns of public rows only.

pieces.name: What every test shares: counter, free port, a database of its own, a real server, a cookie-jar client
pieces.note: Database names are linkedm_t_*; adds a stand-in SMTP server (a real mail conversation) and a sign-in helper.

pieces.name: A real Chromium, a phone and a desk, every page error collected
pieces.note: Only the screenshot environment name changes.

pieces.name: Every test, each in its own process and database, to the true end
pieces.note: This product's test list; drops the image and mutation tests.

pieces.name: The server boots alone in production mode, old and fresh database, and every refusal
pieces.note: Same structure; this product's settings, health answer and refusals.

pieces.name: No dark surface on any page, at 390 and 1440, and it can fail
pieces.note: Same method (stylesheet tokens, painted pages, a dark panel is caught); adds a check for red and for contrast.

pieces.name: The database as every person
pieces.note: Same method; this product's rules.

pieces.name: The whole thing over HTTP
pieces.note: Same method; adds the stand-in mail server.

pieces.name: Real clicks at 390 and 1440
pieces.note: Same method; this product's journey.

pieces.name: Names, claims, licences, commons.json, no key in the repository
pieces.note: The licence check, the commons check, the no-key scan and the migration checks are the original's.

pieces.name: Eden's orange orb, drawn on a canvas
pieces.note: The drawing (state table, four blobs, seeded mesh, nucleus, vignette, glint, the amber and copper numbers) is copied as it was; only the framework layer changed, a plain mount function instead of a component. Read only at the origin; the origin file is not edited.

pieces.name: CI: a fresh Postgres 16 and a real Chromium, every test
pieces.note: Names only.

pieces.name: DEPLOY.md written for the founder: one-line commands, spaces marked and counted, step tables, zero versus O, never a password in chat
pieces.note: Same form; this product's steps and variables.

pieces.name: CLAUDE.md: working rules, hard rules, founder communication rules
pieces.note: Same form; this product's hard rules.

pieces.name: .env.example: names only, no values
pieces.note: This product's variables.

pieces.name: package.json and package-lock.json: express, nodemailer, pg
pieces.note: Name and description; the same three dependencies. Express is pinned at 4.22.3, the first release past the 2026 advisories on body-parser, path-to-regexp and qs, so the lockfile is no longer the original's.
